scoring.method: main-engine display capture compared pixelwise to an independent software reference renderer
scoring.per_test_score: matched pixels / 49152, displayed as a percentage
scoring.total_score: sum of matched pixels / (49152 * 8), displayed as a percentage
scoring.reference_note: Reference is spec-derived software rendering, not a captured hardware golden. It reads the test's programmed tile/map/palette inputs, so setup-memory writes are not independently verified.
scoring.capture_limitation: DS display capture scores the composed main 2D engine only. The sub engine is kept in Mode 0 with only BG0 enabled for the status console; tests do not write its VRAM, palette, layer, or blend registers.
scoring.timeout_handling: VCOUNT/frame-boundary polling and capture polling are bounded. If video scanlines stall or capture does not complete before its poll budget expires, the card is reported as FRAME/CAPTURE TIMEOUT, skipped, and execution continues. Timed-out cards are excluded from the valid pixel-match total.
